tasks.title: Reconcile ledger and vesting

tasks.evidence: Annual filings, taxes, qualifications and approvals

tasks.title: Map data, purposes and vendors
tasks.evidence: Processing inventory, roles, retention and regions

tasks.title: Review ToS and enterprise risk terms
tasks.evidence: Terms, disclosures, caps and indemnities

tasks.evidence: DPA, annexes, applicable transfer/education requirements

tasks.title: Validate SLA and security promises
tasks.evidence: Measured reliability, support and control evidence
